sections.heading: SHAPE BASE CLASS
sections.content:
The `Shape` abstract class in namespace `UnityEngine.ProBuilder.Shapes` serves as the base class for all procedural primitive generators. It is decorated with `[System.Serializable]`, enabling polymorphism when serialized via `[SerializeReference]` inside the `ProBuilderShape` component.

1. Abstract and Virtual Interface Methods:
- `public virtual Bounds UpdateBounds(ProBuilderMesh mesh, Vector3 size, Quaternion rotation, Bounds bounds)`: Allows individual shapes to customize how their bounding volume is computed. The default implementation returns `mesh.mesh.bounds`. Subclasses like `Cone`, `Cylinder`, `Pipe`, `Sphere`, `Torus`, and `Stairs` override this method to account for rotation axes or explicit radial dimensions.
- `public abstract Bounds RebuildMesh(ProBuilderMesh mesh, Vector3 size, Quaternion rotation)`: Primary generation method implemented by each shape. Constructs vertex positions, topology (faces), smoothing groups, and UV unwrapping configurations according to the provided bounding `size` (`Vector3`) and orientation `rotation` (`Quaternion`). Returns the resulting `Bounds`.
- `public abstract void CopyShape(Shape shape)`: Deep-copies property values from an existing `Shape` instance of matching runtime type, used during shape type switching or shape duplication in the editor.
- `internal abstract void SetParametersToBuiltInShape()`: Resets shape parameters to historical built-in defaults used by legacy presets.

2. Shape Attribute:
- `ShapeAttribute`: Marked with `[System.AttributeUsage(System.AttributeTargets.Class)]`. Exposes `public string name;` which identifies the user-facing name of the primitive (e.g. `[Shape("Cube")]`, `[Shape("Arch")]`, `[Shape("Stairs")]`). Editor menus and reflection utilities discover available primitives via this attribute.

3. Rebuild and Update Lifecycle:
- Geometric reconstruction is orchestrated by `ProBuilderShape.Rebuild()`. When invoked, it executes `m_Shape.RebuildMesh(mesh, size, shapeRotation)`.
- The returned bounding box `bbox` is normalized via `bbox.size = Math.Abs(bbox.size)`.
- `MeshUtility.FitToSize(mesh, bbox, size)` scales the mesh positions to exactly fit the target bounding box size.
- `ProBuilderShape.m_UnmodifiedMeshVersion` is synchronized with `mesh.versionIndex`. If a user manually modifies mesh vertices/faces through ProBuilder editing tools, `mesh.versionIndex` increments, which causes `ProBuilderShape.isEditable` to evaluate to `false`, detaching parametric rebuilding to preserve direct mesh edits.
sections.godot_notes: In Godot 4, this maps to an abstract Resource class (`Shape3DGenerator` or `PrimitiveGenerator`) deriving from `Resource` with `@export` properties. The `rebuild_mesh(mesh: ArrayMesh, size: Vector3, rotation: Quaternion) -> AABB` method can construct surface arrays for `Mesh.PRIMITIVE_TRIANGLES` via `SurfaceTool` or `MeshDataTool`.

sections.heading: PROBUILDER SHAPE COMPONENT
sections.content:
The `ProBuilderShape` component (`sealed class ProBuilderShape : MonoBehaviour`) acts as the high-level manager component bridging a parametric `Shape` instance with the underlying `ProBuilderMesh` component. It is decorated with `[Icon(k_IconPath)]`, `[AddComponentMenu("")]`, `[DisallowMultipleComponent]`, and `[HelpURL(k_HelpUrl)]`.

1. Constants:
- `k_HelpUrl` (`string`): `"https://docs.unity3d.com/Packages/com.unity.probuilder@latest"`.
- `k_IconPath` (`string`): `"Packages/com.unity.probuilder/Editor Default Resources/Icons/EditableMesh/EditableMesh.png"`.
- `k_MinHeight` (`float`): `0.0001f`.

2. Serialized Fields and Internal State:
- `[SerializeReference] Shape m_Shape`: Polymorphic reference to the active primitive generator (defaults to `new Cube()`).
- `[SerializeField] Quaternion m_ShapeRotation`: Orientation of the shape within the bounding box (defaults to `Quaternion.identity`).
- `[SerializeField] internal ushort m_UnmodifiedMeshVersion`: Tracks `mesh.versionIndex` from the last rebuild to detect manual mesh edits.
- `[SerializeField] Vector3 m_Size`: Target dimensions (defaults to `Vector3.one`). On validation or property set, `m_Size.x` and `m_Size.z` are clamped if zero to `0.001f` (preserving sign) to prevent zero-volume geometry and PhysX collision errors.
- `[SerializeField] Vector3 m_LocalCenter`: Position of the bounding box center in object local space.
- `[SerializeField] Vector3 m_PivotRatio`: Per-axis fraction `[-1f, 1f]` indicating how far the pivot sits from the bounding box center relative to half-size (`RatioOrZero(m_LocalCenter.axis, bounds.size.axis)`). Preserves the relative pivot offset during bounds resizing.

3. Properties:
- `public Shape shape => m_Shape`
- `public Vector3 size`: Getter/setter with zero-clamp handling on X/Z components.
- `public Quaternion shapeRotation`: Getter/setter for `m_ShapeRotation`.
- `public Vector3 shapeWorldCenter => transform.TransformPoint(m_LocalCenter)`
- `public Bounds editionBounds`: Local bounds using `m_LocalCenter` and `m_Size`, flattening Y to 0 if `Mathf.Abs(m_Size.y) < k_MinHeight`.
- `public Bounds shapeLocalBounds => new Bounds(m_LocalCenter, size)`
- `public Bounds shapeWorldBounds => new Bounds(shapeWorldCenter, size)`
- `public bool isEditable => m_UnmodifiedMeshVersion == mesh.versionIndex`: Indicates whether the mesh is still procedurally editable or has been modified by direct vertex/edge/face operations.
- `public ProBuilderMesh mesh`: Auto-resolves or adds `ProBuilderMesh` component on the game object.

4. Lifecycle and Rebuild Pipeline:
- `UpdateShape()`: Computes `newLocalCenter = Vector3.Scale(m_PivotRatio, size * 0.5f)` and calls `Rebuild(mesh.transform.position, mesh.transform.rotation, new Bounds(newWorldCenter, size))`.
- `Rebuild(Vector3 pivotPosition, Quaternion rotation, Bounds bounds)`: Aligns `transform.position = bounds.center`, `transform.rotation = rotation`, updates `size = bounds.size`, calls `Rebuild()`, repositions pivot via `mesh.SetPivot(pivotPosition)`, calculates `m_LocalCenter` and `m_PivotRatio`, and synchronizes `m_UnmodifiedMeshVersion = mesh.versionIndex`.
- `Rebuild()`: Calls `m_Shape.RebuildMesh(mesh, size, shapeRotation)` followed by `MeshUtility.FitToSize(mesh, bbox, size)`.
- `SetShape(Shape shape)`: Manages transitions between 2D flat shapes (`Plane`, `Sprite`) and 3D shapes. When switching to 2D, zeros the Y dimension. When transitioning from 2D to 3D, restores `m_Size.y = 1f` if below `k_MinHeight`. Calls `UpdateShape()` and updates `m_UnmodifiedMeshVersion`.
- `RotateInsideBounds(Quaternion deltaRotation)`: Updates `shapeRotation = deltaRotation * shapeRotation` and rebuilds the mesh preserving world bounds.
sections.godot_notes: In Godot 4, a `ProBuilderShape3D` node can extend `Node3D` containing an `@export var shape_generator: PrimitiveGenerator` resource and an internal `ArrayMesh`. Editability tracking can compare a generation sequence counter against mesh edit transactions.

sections.heading: FOR EACH SHAPE: CUBE
sections.content:
The `Cube` shape (`[Shape("Cube")] public class Cube : Shape`) creates a standard six-sided box primitive.

1. Configurable Parameters:
- The `Cube` class has no shape-specific properties. `SetParametersToBuiltInShape()` and `CopyShape(Shape shape)` are empty no-op methods.
- The editor property drawer `CubeDrawer` provides an empty `OnGUI` implementation.

2. Static Template Geometry:
- Template vertices `k_CubeVertices` (`Vector3[8]`):
  - Bottom 4 vertices: `(-0.5, -0.5, 0.5)` [0], `(0.5, -0.5, 0.5)` [1], `(0.5, -0.5, -0.5)` [2], `(-0.5, -0.5, -0.5)` [3].
  - Top 4 vertices: `(-0.5, 0.5, 0.5)` [4], `(0.5, 0.5, 0.5)` [5], `(0.5, 0.5, -0.5)` [6], `(-0.5, 0.5, -0.5)` [7].
- Face winding indices `k_CubeTriangles` (`int[24]`): Groups of 4 vertex indices per quad face:
  - Front quad: `0, 1, 4, 5`
  - Right quad: `1, 2, 5, 6`
  - Back quad: `2, 3, 6, 7`
  - Left quad: `3, 0, 7, 4`
  - Top quad: `4, 5, 7, 6`
  - Bottom quad: `3, 2, 0, 1`

3. Generation Algorithm (`RebuildMesh`):
- Initializes `points = new Vector3[24]`.
- For each index `i` from `0` to `23`: `points[i] = rotation * Vector3.Scale(k_CubeVertices[k_CubeTriangles[i]], Math.Abs(size))`.
- Invokes `mesh.GeometryWithPoints(points)` which constructs 6 discrete quad `Face` instances with coincident vertex indices grouped into `SharedVertex` arrays.
- UV unwrapping: Sets `UvUnwrapping.SetAutoUV(mesh, mesh.facesInternal, true)`.
- Sets face anchor: For each face in `mesh.facesInternal`, sets `face.uv = new AutoUnwrapSettings(face.uv) { anchor = AutoUnwrapSettings.Anchor.UpperLeft }`.
- Calls `mesh.RefreshUV(mesh.faces)` and returns `mesh.mesh.bounds`.
sections.godot_notes: Godot 4 BoxMesh generates 24 vertices for hard-edged face normals. `GeometryWithPoints` constructs independent quads and associates shared vertices by coordinate proximity.

sections.heading: FOR EACH SHAPE: ARCH
sections.content:
The `Arch` shape (`[Shape("Arch")] public class Arch : Shape`) constructs a curved cylindrical arch/tunnel segment with configurable thickness, sweep angle, and end caps.

1. Configurable Parameters:
- `m_Thickness` (`float`): `[Min(0.01f)]`, default `0.1f` (built-in preset `1.0f`). Radial thickness of the arch opening in meters.
- `m_NumberOfSides` (`int`): `[Range(2, 200)]`, default `5` (built-in preset `8`). Number of radial polygon segments across the circumference.
- `m_ArchDegrees` (`float`): `[Range(1, 360)]`, default `180f` (built-in preset `180f`). Total circumferential sweep in degrees.
- `m_EndCaps` (`bool`): default `true` (built-in preset `true`). Generates closing polygons at the start and end of the arch if `m_ArchDegrees < 360f`.
- `m_Smooth` (`bool`): default `true` (built-in preset `false`). Enables smoothing group `1` across curved inner and outer wall faces.

2. Helper Methods:
- `GetFace(Vector2 vertex1, Vector2 vertex2, float depth)`: Generates 4 vertices for a quad connecting two 2D profile points across the front and back planes: `(v1.x, v1.y, depth)`, `(v2.x, v2.y, depth)`, `(v1.x, v1.y, -depth)`, `(v2.x, v2.y, -depth)`.

3. Generation Algorithm (`RebuildMesh`):
- Direction vectors: `upDir = Vector3.Scale(rotation * Vector3.up, size)`, `rightDir = Vector3.Scale(rotation * Vector3.right, size)`, `forwardDir = Vector3.Scale(rotation * Vector3.forward, size)`.
- Radii calculations: `xRadius = rightDir.magnitude / 2f`, `yRadius = upDir.magnitude`, `depth = forwardDir.magnitude / 2f`.
- Angle compensation:
  - If `angle < 90f`: `xRadius *= 2f`.
  - Else if `angle < 180f`: `xRadius *= 1f + Mathf.Lerp(1f, 0f, Mathf.Abs(Mathf.Cos(angle * Mathf.Deg2Rad)))`.
  - Else if `angle > 180f`: `yRadius /= 1f + Mathf.Lerp(0f, 1f, (angle - 180f) / 90f)`.
- `radialCuts = m_NumberOfSides + 1`.
- Generates outer and inner profile coordinates `templateOut` and `templateIn` of length `radialCuts` using `Math.PointInEllipseCircumference`:
  - `templateOut[i] = Math.PointInEllipseCircumference(xRadius, yRadius, currentAngle, Vector2.zero, out tangent)`.
  - `templateIn[i] = Math.PointInEllipseCircumference(xRadius - m_Thickness, yRadius - m_Thickness, currentAngle, Vector2.zero, out tangent)`.
- Circumferential faces loop (`n` from `0` to `radialCuts - 2`):
  - Outside quads via `GetFace(templateOut[n], templateOut[n+1], -depth)`.
  - Inside quads via `GetFace(templateIn[n+1], templateIn[n], -depth)`.
  - Left end cap (if `angle < 360f && m_EndCaps` and `n == 0`): `GetFace(templateOut[n], templateIn[n], depth)`.
  - Right end cap (if `angle < 360f && m_EndCaps` and `n == radialCuts - 2`): `GetFace(templateIn[n+1], templateOut[n+1], depth)`.
- Front and back capping faces (`i` from `0` to `radialCuts - 2`):
  - Front quad `tpb`: `(tmp.x, tmp.y, depth)`, `(tmp2.x, tmp2.y, depth)`, `(tmp3.x, tmp3.y, depth)`, `(tmp4.x, tmp4.y, depth)`.
  - Back quad `tpt`: `(tmp2.x, tmp2.y, -depth)`, `(tmp.x, tmp.y, -depth)`, `(tmp4.x, tmp4.y, -depth)`, `(tmp3.x, tmp3.y, -depth)`.
- Vertices scaled by `sizeSigns = Math.Sign(size)` and transformed by `rotation`.
- `mesh.GeometryWithPoints(v.ToArray())`.
- Smoothing: If `m_Smooth`, sets `face.smoothingGroup = 1` for curved faces starting at index `(angle < 360f && m_EndCaps) ? 1 : 0` through `smoothedFaceCount`.
- Parity check: If `sizeSign < 0`, reverses all faces via `face.Reverse()`.
- Centering: `mesh.TranslateVerticesInWorldSpace(mesh.mesh.triangles, mesh.transform.TransformDirection(-mesh.mesh.bounds.center))` and `mesh.Refresh()`.
sections.godot_notes: The radius scaling formulas adjust the elliptical bounds when the arch angle is not 180 degrees. Centering moves the geometric centroid to the origin before pivot offset calculations.

sections.heading: FOR EACH SHAPE: CONE
sections.content:
The `Cone` shape (`[Shape("Cone")] public class Cone : Shape`) creates a tapered conical mesh with a polygonal base.

1. Configurable Parameters:
- `m_NumberOfSides` (`int`): `[Range(3, 64)]`, default `6` (built-in preset `8`). Number of sides around the cone axis.
- `m_Radius` (`float`): runtime field set to `System.Math.Min(meshSize.x, meshSize.z)` during rebuild (built-in preset `0.5f`).
- `m_Smooth` (`bool`): `[SerializeField]`, default `true` (built-in preset `false`). Enables smoothing group `1` on side faces.

2. Bounds Calculation (`UpdateBounds`):
- Computes `upLocalAxis = Math.Abs(rotation * Vector3.up)`.
- Linearly interpolates bounds dimension: `boxSize.x = Mathf.Lerp(m_Radius * 2f, boxSize.x, upLocalAxis.x)`, `boxSize.y = Mathf.Lerp(m_Radius * 2f, boxSize.y, upLocalAxis.y)`, `boxSize.z = Mathf.Lerp(m_Radius * 2f, boxSize.z, upLocalAxis.z)`.

3. Generation Algorithm (`RebuildMesh`):
- `meshSize = Math.Abs(size)`, `m_Radius = Min(meshSize.x, meshSize.z)`, `height = meshSize.y`.
- Base ring: `template = new Vector3[subdivAxis]` where `template[i] = new Vector3(ct.x, -height / 2f, ct.y)` computed from `Math.PointInCircumference(m_Radius, i * (360f / subdivAxis), Vector2.zero)`.
- Vertex construction: For each segment `i` from `0` to `subdivAxis - 1`:
  - Side triangle: `template[i]`, `template[i+1]`, `Vector3.up * height / 2f`.
  - Bottom triangle: `template[i]`, `template[i+1]`, `Vector3.down * height / 2f`.
- Face topology:
  - Side face: `Face(new int[3] { i + 2, i + 1, i + 0 })` with `smoothingGroup = m_Smooth ? 1 : 0`.
  - Bottom face: `Face(new int[3] { i + 3, i + 4, i + 5 })`.
- Transformed by `rotation` and scaled by `sizeSigns = Math.Sign(size)`. Reverses faces if `sizeSign < 0`.
- Invokes `mesh.RebuildWithPositionsAndFaces(v, f)`.
- UV Unwrapping: Sets `mesh.unwrapParameters = new UnwrapParameters() { packMargin = 30f }`.
- Sets first side face UV: `firstFace.uv.anchor = AutoUnwrapSettings.Anchor.LowerLeft`, `firstFace.manualUV = true`.
- Projects first face with `UvUnwrapping.Unwrap(mesh, firstFace, projection: Vector3.up)`.
- Copies UV coordinates from `firstFace` to all other side faces via `UvUnwrapping.CopyUVs(mesh, firstFace, sideFace)`.
- Refreshes UV via `mesh.RefreshUV(sideFaces)` and returns `UpdateBounds(mesh, size, rotation, new Bounds())`.
sections.godot_notes: Copying UVs from the first side face ensures texture alignment across all cone sides. In Godot, planar projection along the Y axis achieves identical alignment.

sections.heading: FOR EACH SHAPE: CYLINDER
sections.content:
The `Cylinder` shape (`[Shape("Cylinder")] public class Cylinder : Shape`) generates a solid cylinder with configurable radial divisions, height cuts, and end caps.

1. Configurable Parameters:
- `m_AxisDivisions` (`int`): `[SerializeField] [Range(3, 64)]`, default `6` (built-in preset `8`). Number of circumferential segments around the cylinder.
- `m_HeightCuts` (`int`): `[Min(0)] [SerializeField]`, default `0` (built-in preset `2`). Number of horizontal subdivisions along cylinder height.
- `m_Smooth` (`bool`): `[SerializeField]`, default `true` (built-in preset `false`). Enables smoothing group `1` on wall faces.

2. Bounds Calculation (`UpdateBounds`):
- Assigns `bounds.size = size` and returns `bounds`.

3. Generation Algorithm (`RebuildMesh`):
- Dimensions: `height = upDir.magnitude`, `xRadius = rightDir.magnitude / 2f`, `zRadius = forwardDir.magnitude / 2f`.
- Height step: `heightStep = height / (m_HeightCuts + 1)`.
- Circumferential circle points: `circle = new Vector2[m_AxisDivisions]`, evaluated via `Math.PointInEllipseCircumference(xRadius, zRadius, i * 360f / m_AxisDivisions, Vector2.zero, out _)`.
- Total vertex allocation: `(m_AxisDivisions * (m_HeightCuts + 1) * 4) + (m_AxisDivisions * 6)`.
- Total face allocation: `m_AxisDivisions * (m_HeightCuts + 1) + (m_AxisDivisions * 2)`.
- Wall vertex construction: Iterates `i` from `0` to `m_HeightCuts`, calculating `Y = i * heightStep - height * 0.5f` and `Y2 = (i + 1) * heightStep - height * 0.5f`. Generates 4 vertices per sector.
- Wall face winding: Iterates height cuts and axis divisions to build quad faces with winding `new Face(new int[6] { zero, one, two, one, three, two }, 0, AutoUnwrapSettings.tile, m_Smooth ? 1 : -1, -1, -1, false)`.
- End caps:
  - Bottom cap: For each sector `n`, creates triangle `Face(new int[3] { ind + 2, ind + 1, ind + 0 })` connecting `circle[n]`, center `(0, -height*0.5, 0)`, and `circle[n+1]`.
  - Top cap: For each sector `n`, creates triangle `Face(new int[3] { ind + 0, ind + 1, ind + 2 })` connecting `circle[n]`, center `(0, height*0.5, 0)`, and `circle[n+1]`.
- Vertices transformed by `rotation`.
- Rebuilds via `mesh.RebuildWithPositionsAndFaces(vertices, faces)` and returns `UpdateBounds(mesh, size, rotation, new Bounds())`.
sections.godot_notes: Godot CylinderMesh generates shared vertices at top/bottom caps. ProBuilder keeps cap vertices unshared from side quads to avoid normal smoothing artifacts.

sections.heading: FOR EACH SHAPE: DOOR
sections.content:
The `Door` shape (`[Shape("Door")] public class Door : Shape`) creates a doorway frame with a cutout opening designed to fit flush into a wall.

1. Configurable Parameters:
- `m_DoorHeight` (`float`): `[Min(0.01f)] [SerializeField]`, default `0.5f` (built-in preset `0.5f`). Height of the pediment lintel at the top of the door frame in meters.
- `m_LegWidth` (`float`): `[Min(0.01f)] [SerializeField]`, default `0.75f` (built-in preset `0.75f`). Width of the vertical frame jambs on each side of the opening in meters.

2. Generation Algorithm (`RebuildMesh`):
- Dimension calculations: `totalWidth = rightDir.magnitude`, `totalHeight = upDir.magnitude`, `depth = forwardDir.magnitude`.
- Leg width coordinate: `xLegCoord = totalWidth / 2f`, `legWidth = (xLegCoord - m_LegWidth > 0) ? (xLegCoord - m_LegWidth) : 0.001f`.
- Ledge height coordinate: `ledgeHeight = (totalHeight - m_DoorHeight * 2f > 0) ? (totalHeight - m_DoorHeight * 2f) : 0.001f`.
- Template vertices on front plane (12 points at `front = depth / 2f`):
  - Row 0 (base `baseY = -totalHeight`): `(-xLegCoord, baseY, front)` [0], `(-legWidth, baseY, front)` [1], `(legWidth, baseY, front)` [2], `(xLegCoord, baseY, front)` [3].
  - Row 1 (lintel base `ledgeHeight`): `(-xLegCoord, ledgeHeight, front)` [4], `(-legWidth, ledgeHeight, front)` [5], `(legWidth, ledgeHeight, front)` [6], `(xLegCoord, ledgeHeight, front)` [7].
  - Row 2 (top `totalHeight`): `(-xLegCoord, totalHeight, front)` [8], `(-legWidth, totalHeight, front)` [9], `(legWidth, totalHeight, front)` [10], `(xLegCoord, totalHeight, front)` [11].
- Front quads: 5 quads formed by points: `(4, 0, 5, 1)`, `(2, 3, 6, 7)`, `(4, 5, 8, 9)`, `(10, 6, 11, 7)`, `(5, 6, 9, 10)`.
- Back quads: 5 matching quads translated by `-Vector3.forward * depth` with winding reversed `(i+0, i+2, i+1, i+3)`.
- Frame inner opening faces (3 quads):
  - Lintel underside: `template[6]`, `template[5]`, `template[6] - forward * depth`, `template[5] - forward * depth`.
  - Right inner jamb: `template[2] - forward * depth`, `template[2]`, `template[6] - forward * depth`, `template[6]`.
  - Left inner jamb: `template[1]`, `template[1] - forward * depth`, `template[5]`, `template[5] - forward * depth`.
- Scaled by `rotation` and `sizeSigns`. Reverses faces if `sizeSign < 0`.
- Builds geometry via `mesh.GeometryWithPoints(points.ToArray())` and returns `mesh.mesh.bounds`.
sections.godot_notes: The door primitive omits outer side and bottom faces so that it slots into existing geometry walls without internal invisible polygons.

sections.heading: FOR EACH SHAPE: PIPE
sections.content:
The `Pipe` shape (`[Shape("Pipe")] public class Pipe : Shape`) constructs a hollow cylindrical tube with configurable wall thickness, radial sides, and height cuts.

1. Configurable Parameters:
- `m_Thickness` (`float`): `[Min(0.01f)] [SerializeField]`, default `0.25f` (built-in preset `0.25f`). Radial thickness of the pipe wall in meters.
- `m_NumberOfSides` (`int`): `[Range(3, 64)] [SerializeField]`, default `6` (built-in preset `8`). Number of sides around the circumference.
- `m_HeightCuts` (`int`): `[Range(0, 31)] [SerializeField]`, default `0` (built-in preset `2`). Number of horizontal cuts along the pipe height.
- `m_Smooth` (`bool`): `[SerializeField]`, default `true` (built-in preset `false`). Enables smoothing group `1` on outer and inner wall faces.

2. Bounds Calculation (`UpdateBounds`):
- Assigns `bounds.size = size` and returns `bounds`.

3. Generation Algorithm (`RebuildMesh`):
- Radii: `height = upDir.magnitude`, `xRadius = rightDir.magnitude / 2f`, `zRadius = forwardDir.magnitude / 2f`.
- Outer ring `templateOut` and inner ring `templateIn` of length `m_NumberOfSides`:
  - `templateOut[i] = Math.PointInEllipseCircumference(xRadius, zRadius, i * (360f / m_NumberOfSides), Vector2.zero, out tangent)`.
  - Orthogonal tangent: `tangentOrtho = new Vector2(-tangent.y, tangent.x)`.
  - `templateIn[i] = templateOut[i] + (m_Thickness * tangentOrtho)`.
- Wall quads loop: Iterates `i` from `0` to `m_HeightCuts` with `y = i * (height / heightSegments) - baseY` and `y2 = (i + 1) * (height / heightSegments) - baseY`.
  - Outside quad `qvo`: `(tmp2.x, y, tmp2.y)`, `(tmp.x, y, tmp.y)`, `(tmp2.x, y2, tmp2.y)`, `(tmp.x, y2, tmp.y)`.
  - Inside quad `qvi`: `(tmp.x, y, tmp.y)`, `(tmp2.x, y, tmp2.y)`, `(tmp.x, y2, tmp.y)`, `(tmp2.x, y2, tmp2.y)`.
- Top and bottom rim quads (`i` from `0` to `m_NumberOfSides - 1`):
  - Top rim `tpt`: `(tmp2.x, height-baseY, tmp2.y)`, `(tmp.x, height-baseY, tmp.y)`, `(tmp4.x, height-baseY, tmp4.y)`, `(tmp3.x, height-baseY, tmp3.y)`.
  - Bottom rim `tpb`: `(tmp.x, -baseY, tmp.y)`, `(tmp2.x, -baseY, tmp2.y)`, `(tmp3.x, -baseY, tmp3.y)`, `(tmp4.x, -baseY, tmp4.y)`.
- Vertices transformed by `rotation`.
- `mesh.GeometryWithPoints(v.ToArray())`.
- Smoothing: If `m_Smooth`, sets `smoothingGroup = 1` for all `2 * heightSegments * m_NumberOfSides` side wall faces.
- Returns `UpdateBounds(mesh, size, rotation, new Bounds())`.
sections.godot_notes: Pipe generates both outer and inner concentric cylindrical shells connected by top and bottom annular rings. The orthogonal tangent calculation ensures uniform wall thickness on elliptical profiles.

sections.heading: FOR EACH SHAPE: PLANE
sections.content:
The `Plane` shape (`[Shape("Plane")] public class Plane : Shape`) constructs a flat subdivided 2D grid mesh lying on the XZ plane.

1. Configurable Parameters:
- `m_HeightSegments` (`int`): `[Min(0)] [SerializeField]`, default `1` (built-in preset `5`). Number of divisions along the length (Z-axis).
- `m_WidthSegments` (`int`): `[Min(0)] [SerializeField]`, default `1` (built-in preset `5`). Number of divisions along the width (X-axis).

2. Generation Algorithm (`RebuildMesh`):
- Grid dimensions: `w = m_WidthSegments + 1`, `h = m_HeightSegments + 1`.
- Total vertex allocation: `Vector2[(w * h) * 4] p`, `Vector3[(w * h) * 4] v`.
- 2D grid iteration:
  - Iterates rows `y` from `0` to `h - 1` and columns `x` from `0` to `w - 1`.
  - Computes coordinates: `x0 = x * (width / w) - (width / 2f)`, `x1 = (x + 1) * (width / w) - (width / 2f)`, `y0 = y * (height / h) - (height / 2f)`, `y1 = (y + 1) * (height / h) - (height / 2f)`.
  - Assigns 4 vertices per quad: `p[i+0] = (x0, y0)`, `p[i+1] = (x1, y0)`, `p[i+2] = (x0, y1)`, `p[i+3] = (x1, y1)`.
- 3D vertex mapping: Maps 2D coordinates to 3D XZ plane: `v[i] = new Vector3(p[i].y, 0f, p[i].x)`.
- Constructs geometry via `mesh.GeometryWithPoints(v)` and returns `mesh.mesh.bounds`.
sections.godot_notes: Godot PlaneMesh creates a quad mesh with `subdivide_width` and `subdivide_depth`. `Plane.cs` creates distinct non-shared quad faces.

sections.heading: FOR EACH SHAPE: PRISM
sections.content:
The `Prism` shape (`[Shape("Prism")] public class Prism : Shape`) creates a 5-sided triangular prism primitive stretched along the Z-axis.

1. Configurable Parameters:
- The `Prism` shape has no shape-specific properties. `SetParametersToBuiltInShape()` and `CopyShape(Shape shape)` are empty no-op methods.
- The editor property drawer `PrismDrawer` provides an empty `OnGUI` implementation.

2. Generation Algorithm (`RebuildMesh`):
- Dimension setup: `meshSize = Math.Abs(size)`, `baseY = new Vector3(0, meshSize.y / 2f, 0)`, `meshSize.y *= 2f`.
- 6 template vertices:
  - Front triangle: `Vector3.Scale(new Vector3(-0.5f, 0f, -0.5f), meshSize) - baseY` [0], `Vector3.Scale(new Vector3(0.5f, 0f, -0.5f), meshSize) - baseY` [1], `Vector3.Scale(new Vector3(0f, 0.5f, -0.5f), meshSize) - baseY` [2].
  - Back triangle: `Vector3.Scale(new Vector3(-0.5f, 0f, 0.5f), meshSize) - baseY` [3], `Vector3.Scale(new Vector3(0.5f, 0f, 0.5f), meshSize) - baseY` [4], `Vector3.Scale(new Vector3(0f, 0.5f, 0.5f), meshSize) - baseY` [5].
- 18 vertices `v`:
  - Front triangle (3 verts): `template[0]`, `template[1]`, `template[2]`.
  - Right slope quad (4 verts): `template[1]`, `template[4]`, `template[2]`, `template[5]`.
  - Back triangle (3 verts): `template[4]`, `template[3]`, `template[5]`.
  - Left slope quad (4 verts): `template[3]`, `template[0]`, `template[5]`, `template[2]`.
  - Bottom quad (4 verts): `template[0]`, `template[1]`, `template[3]`, `template[4]`.
- 5 Face instances `f`:
  - Front: `Face(new int[3] { 2, 1, 0 })`
  - Right side: `Face(new int[6] { 5, 4, 3, 5, 6, 4 })`
  - Back: `Face(new int[3] { 9, 8, 7 })`
  - Left side: `Face(new int[6] { 12, 11, 10, 12, 13, 11 })`
  - Bottom: `Face(new int[6] { 14, 15, 16, 15, 17, 16 })`
- Scaling and orientation: `v[i] = Vector3.Scale(rotation * v[i], sizeSigns)`.
- Parity check: If `sizeSign < 0`, reverses all faces via `face.Reverse()`.
- Rebuilds geometry via `mesh.RebuildWithPositionsAndFaces(v, f)` and returns `mesh.mesh.bounds`.
sections.godot_notes: Godot PrismMesh creates a triangular prism with configurable apex offset. ProBuilder's Prism fixes the apex centered at top with 5 independent faces.

sections.heading: FOR EACH SHAPE: SPHERE
sections.content:
The `Sphere` shape (`[Shape("Sphere")] public class Sphere : Shape`) creates an icosphere based on recursive triangle subdivision of a regular icosahedron.

1. Configurable Parameters:
- `m_Subdivisions` (`int`): `[Range(1, 5)] [SerializeField]`, default `3` (built-in preset `2`). Number of recursive subdivisions applied to each icosahedron triangle.
- `m_BottomMostVertexIndex` (`int`): Runtime index of the lowest vertex on the Y-axis.
- `m_Smooth` (`bool`): `[SerializeField]`, default `true` (built-in preset `false`). Enables smoothing group `1` on all faces.

2. Static Template Geometry:
- `k_IcosphereVertices` (`Vector3[12]`): Built using the golden ratio `Math.phi = (1 + Mathf.Sqrt(5f)) / 2f` (~1.618034f): `(-1, phi, 0)`, `(1, phi, 0)`, `(-1, -phi, 0)`, `(1, -phi, 0)`, `(0, -1, phi)`, `(0, 1, phi)`, `(0, -1, -phi)`, `(0, 1, -phi)`, `(phi, 0, -1)`, `(phi, 0, 1)`, `(-phi, 0, -1)`, `(-phi, 0, 1)`.
- `k_IcosphereTriangles` (`int[60]`): 20 triangular faces forming a regular icosahedron.

3. Generation Algorithm (`RebuildMesh`):
- Generates base icosahedron vertices: `v[i] = k_IcosphereVertices[k_IcosphereTriangles[i]].normalized * radius` (`radius = 0.5f`).
- Recursive subdivision loop (`m_Subdivisions` times):
  - `SubdivideIcosahedron(v, radius)` splits each triangle `(p0, p2, p5)` into 4 smaller triangles using normalized midpoint vectors: `p1 = ((p0 + p2) * 0.5f).normalized * radius`, `p3 = ((p0 + p5) * 0.5f).normalized * radius`, `p4 = ((p2 + p5) * 0.5f).normalized * radius`.
  - Produces 4 triangles: `(p0, p1, p3)`, `(p1, p2, p4)`, `(p1, p4, p3)`, `(p3, p4, p5)`.
- Face construction: Allocates `Face[v.Length / 3]` with `smoothingGroup = m_Smooth ? 1 : 0`, `manualUV = false`.
- Tracks `m_BottomMostVertexIndex` by scanning for lowest vertex on Y.
- Projection texture groups: For each face, computes face normal via `Math.Normal` and assigns `textureGroup` based on `Projection.VectorToProjectionAxis(nrm)`:
  - `ProjectionAxis.X` -> `2`
  - `ProjectionAxis.Y` -> `3`
  - `ProjectionAxis.Z` -> `4`
  - `ProjectionAxis.XNegative` -> `5`
  - `ProjectionAxis.YNegative` -> `6`
  - `ProjectionAxis.ZNegative` -> `7`
- UV unwrapping: `mesh.unwrapParameters = new UnwrapParameters() { packMargin = 30f }`.
- Rebuilds geometry via `mesh.RebuildWithPositionsAndFaces(v, f)` and returns `UpdateBounds(mesh, size, rotation, new Bounds())`.

sections.godot_notes: Godot SphereMesh is UV sphere based on rings and segments. ProBuilder Sphere is an icosphere with tri-subdivision and 6-axis cube projection texture groups.

sections.heading: FOR EACH SHAPE: SPRITE
sections.content:
The `Sprite` shape (`[Shape("Sprite")] public class Sprite : Shape`) creates a 1x1 quad plane mesh on the XZ plane.

1. Configurable Parameters:
- The `Sprite` shape has no shape-specific properties. `SetParametersToBuiltInShape()` and `CopyShape(Shape shape)` are empty no-op methods.
- The editor property drawer `SpriteDrawer` provides an empty `OnGUI` implementation.

2. Generation Algorithm (`RebuildMesh`):
- `meshSize = Math.Abs(size)`.
- Degenerate dimension check: If `meshSize.x < float.Epsilon || meshSize.z < float.Epsilon`, clears the mesh and returns an empty `Bounds()`.
- 4 2D quad vertices: `p[0] = (-width / 2f, -height / 2f)`, `p[1] = (width / 2f, -height / 2f)`, `p[2] = (-width / 2f, height / 2f)`, `p[3] = (width / 2f, height / 2f)`.
- 1 quad Face with 6 triangle indices: `Face(new int[6] { 0, 1, 2, 1, 3, 2 })`.
- 3D vertex mapping: `v[i] = new Vector3(p[i].y, 0f, p[i].x)`.
- Rebuilds geometry via `mesh.RebuildWithPositionsAndFaces(v, f)` and returns `mesh.mesh.bounds`.
sections.godot_notes: Godot QuadMesh creates a 1x1 quad oriented on the XY or XZ plane. `Sprite.cs` builds a single-face mesh with bounds matching the XZ extents.

sections.heading: FOR EACH SHAPE: STAIRS
sections.content:
The `Stairs` shape (`[Shape("Stairs")] public class Stairs : Shape`) creates straight or curved staircases with configurable step heights, step counts, side walls, and curvature.

1. Enums and Configurable Parameters:
- `StepGenerationType` enum:
  - `Height`: Predictable fixed step height, automatically adapts the number of steps to match the bounding height.
  - `Count`: Fixed number of steps regardless of staircase height.
- `m_StepGenerationType` (`StepGenerationType`): `[SerializeField]`, default `StepGenerationType.Count`.
- `m_StepsHeight` (`float`): `[Min(0.01f)] [SerializeField]`, default `0.2f` (built-in preset `0.4f`). Height of each step when `m_StepGenerationType == StepGenerationType.Height`.
- `m_StepsCount` (`int`): `[Range(1, 256)] [SerializeField]`, default `10` (built-in preset `6`). Step count when `m_StepGenerationType == StepGenerationType.Count`.
- `m_HomogeneousSteps` (`bool`): `[SerializeField]`, default `true` (built-in preset `true`). Forces every step to have identical rounded height.
- `m_Circumference` (`float`): `[Range(-360, 360)] [SerializeField]`, default `0f` (built-in preset `0f`). Curvature of staircase in degrees (0 = straight stairs, positive = right turn, negative = left turn).
- `m_Sides` (`bool`): `[SerializeField]`, default `true` (built-in preset `true`). Generates side and back wall polygons.
- `m_InnerRadius` (`float`): `[Min(0f)] [SerializeField]`, default `0f`. Distance from center to inner edge of curved stairs.

2. Straight Stairs Algorithm (`BuildStairs`):
- Calculates step count and step height: If `useStepHeight`, `steps = (int)(stairsHeight / stepsHeight)`. Clamped to `256`.
- Quad generation: 2 quads (8 vertices) per step:
  - Riser quad: `(x0, y0, z0)`, `(x1, y0, z0)`, `(x0, y1, z0)`, `(x1, y1, z0)`.
  - Tread quad: `(x0, y1, z0)`, `(x1, y1, z0)`, `(x0, y1, z1)`, `(x1, y1, z1)`.
- Side walls (if `sides`): For each side (0 and 1), constructs stepped wall quads and connecting triangles (`i > 0`) with `textureGroup = side + 1`.
- Back wall: Full quad at `z = meshSize.z`.
- Points rotated and scaled by `sizeSigns`. Reverses faces if `sizeSign < 0`.

3. Curved Stairs Algorithm (`BuildCurvedStairs`):
- `cir = Mathf.Abs(circumference) * Mathf.Deg2Rad`, `outerRadius = innerRadius + stairWidth`.
- Per step `i` from `0` to `steps - 1`:
  - Riser quad (4 verts): `v0 * innerRadius`, `v0 * outerRadius`, `v0 * innerRadius (at h1)`, `v0 * outerRadius (at h1)`.
  - Tread quad: 3 vertices if `noInnerSide` (`innerRadius < Epsilon`), 4 vertices otherwise.
  - Tread UV rotation: `uvRotation = ((inc1 + inc0) * -0.5f) * Mathf.Rad2Deg; uvRotation %= 360f; if (uvRotation < 0f) uvRotation = 360f + uvRotation; faces[t+1].uv.rotation = uvRotation`.
- Curved side walls: Generates inner and outer curved wall strips with quad + triangle pairs per step.
- Negative angle handling: If `circumference < 0f`, flips X axis (`new Vector3(-1f, 1f, 1f)`) and reverses face windings.
- Centering: `mesh.TranslateVerticesInWorldSpace(mesh.mesh.triangles, mesh.transform.TransformDirection(-mesh.mesh.bounds.center))` and `mesh.Refresh()`.
sections.godot_notes: Tread UV rotation keeps textures aligned with radial steps as the staircase curves. Step count clamping at 256 prevents excessive geometry creation.

sections.heading: FOR EACH SHAPE: TORUS
sections.content:
The `Torus` shape (`[Shape("Torus")] public class Torus : Shape`) constructs a donut-shaped parametric torus mesh formed by revolving a circular tube cross-section along an elliptical path.

1. Configurable Parameters:
- `m_Rows` (`int`): `[Range(3, 64)] [SerializeField]`, default `16` (built-in preset `12`). Number of faces defining the tube's cross-sectional circumference.
- `m_Columns` (`int`): `[Range(3, 64)] [SerializeField]`, default `24` (built-in preset `16`). Number of slices defining the torus's revolution path.
- `m_TubeRadius` (`float`): `[Min(0.01f)] [SerializeField]`, default `0.1f` (built-in preset `0.3f`). Radius of the revolving tube cross-section in meters.
- `m_HorizontalCircumference` (`float`): `[Range(0, 360)] [SerializeField]`, default `360f` (built-in preset `360f`). Sweep angle of the torus revolution in degrees.
- `m_VerticalCircumference` (`float`): `[Range(0, 360)] [SerializeField]`, default `360f` (built-in preset `360f`). Sweep angle of the tube cross-section in degrees.
- `m_Smooth` (`bool`): `[SerializeField]`, default `true` (built-in preset `true`). Enables smoothing group `1` on torus faces.

2. Cross-Section Helper Methods (`GetCirclePoints`):
- Overload 1: `GetCirclePoints(int segments, float radius, float circumference, Quaternion rotation, float offset)` evaluates 2D circle points along the vertical circumference and rotates them by `rotation` with an X offset.
- Overload 2: `GetCirclePoints(int segments, float radius, float circumference, Quaternion rotation, Vector3 offset)` rotates 2D circle points and adds a 3D `offset` vector.

3. Generation Algorithm (`RebuildMesh`):
- Clamping parameters: `clampedRows = Mathf.Clamp(m_Rows + 1, 4, 128)`, `clampedColumns = Mathf.Clamp(m_Columns + 1, 4, 128)`, `clampedTubeRadius = Mathf.Clamp(m_TubeRadius, 0.01f, Mathf.Min(xOuterRadius, yOuterRadius) - 0.001f)`.
- Revolution loop (`i` from `1` to `clampedColumns - 1`):
  - Angle: `angle = (i / (float)col) * clampedHorizontalCircumference`.
  - Ellipse coordinate: `ellipseCoord = new Vector2(xOuterRadius * Mathf.Cos(Deg2Rad * angle), yOuterRadius * Mathf.Sin(Deg2Rad * angle))`.
  - Tangent direction: `tangent = new Vector2(-ellipseCoord.y / (yOuterRadius * yOuterRadius), ellipseCoord.x / (xOuterRadius * xOuterRadius))`.
  - Slice rotation: `rot = Quaternion.Euler(Vector3.up * Vector2.SignedAngle(Vector2.up, tangent.normalized))`.
  - Evaluates circle slice `cir = GetCirclePoints(clampedRows, clampedTubeRadius, clampedVerticalCircumference, rot, new Vector3(ellipseCoord.x, 0, -ellipseCoord.y))`.
- Face mesh generation: Connects adjacent slices `(i, i+1)` into quads: `Face(new int[] { a, b, c, b, d, c })` with `smoothingGroup = m_Smooth ? 1 : -1`, `manualUV = true`.
- Transformed by `rotation`.
- Rebuilds geometry via `mesh.RebuildWithPositionsAndFaces(vertices, faces)`.
- Centering: `mesh.TranslateVerticesInWorldSpace(mesh.mesh.triangles, mesh.transform.TransformDirection(-mesh.mesh.bounds.center))` and `mesh.Refresh()`.
- Box project UVs: `UVEditing.ProjectFacesBox(mesh, mesh.facesInternal)` and returns `UpdateBounds(mesh, size, rotation, new Bounds())`.
sections.godot_notes: Godot TorusMesh creates a circular torus. ProBuilder Torus supports elliptical major radii and independent vertical/horizontal circumference sweeps.

sections.heading: SHAPE GENERATOR (LEGACY)
sections.content:
The `ShapeGenerator` class (`public static class ShapeGenerator` in namespace `UnityEngine.ProBuilder`) provides the legacy static API for generating primitive `ProBuilderMesh` instances directly without requiring the `ProBuilderShape` component.

1. ShapeType Enum:
- `ShapeType` enum defines: `Cube`, `Stair`, `CurvedStair`, `Prism`, `Cylinder`, `Plane`, `Door`, `Pipe`, `Cone`, `Sprite`, `Arch`, `Sphere`, `Torus`.

2. Central Dispatch Method:
- `public static ProBuilderMesh CreateShape(ShapeType shape, PivotLocation pivotType = PivotLocation.Center)`: Dispatches to the corresponding static generation method with default parameters, sets `pb.gameObject.name = shape.ToString()`, and assigns `pb.renderer.sharedMaterial = BuiltinMaterials.defaultMaterial`.

3. Static Primitive Generation Methods and Parameters:
- `GenerateCube(PivotLocation pivotType, Vector3 size)`: Creates a cube from `k_CubeVertices` and `k_CubeTriangles`. If `pivotType == PivotLocation.Center`, sets UV offset `face.uv.offset = new Vector2(-0.5f, -0.5f)`. Sets pivot via `mesh.SetPivot(pivotType)`.
- `GenerateStair(PivotLocation pivotType, Vector3 size, int steps, bool buildSides)`: Generates straight stairs with `steps` count, riser/tread quads, optional side walls and back face.
- `GenerateCurvedStair(PivotLocation pivotType, float stairWidth, float height, float innerRadius, float circumference, int steps, bool buildSides)`: Generates curved radial stairs with angular sweep `circumference`.
- `GenerateStair(PivotLocation pivotType, int steps, float width, float height, float depth, bool sidesGoToFloor, bool generateBack, bool platformsOnly)`: Internal legacy overload supporting `sidesGoToFloor` and `platformsOnly` toggles.
- `GeneratePrism(PivotLocation pivotType, Vector3 size)`: Creates a triangular prism using 6 template vertices and 5 faces.
- `GenerateCylinder(PivotLocation pivotType, int axisDivisions, float radius, float height, int heightCuts, int smoothing = -1)`: Generates a cylinder with even `axisDivisions` (clamped <= 64), `heightCuts`, and top/bottom fans.
- `GeneratePlane(PivotLocation pivotType, float width, float height, int widthCuts, int heightCuts, Axis axis)`: Generates a subdivided plane oriented along normal axis `Axis.Right`, `Axis.Left`, `Axis.Up`, `Axis.Down`, `Axis.Forward`, or `Axis.Backward`.
- `GenerateDoor(PivotLocation pivotType, float totalWidth, float totalHeight, float ledgeHeight, float legWidth, float depth)`: Generates a doorframe with 5 front quads, 5 back quads, and 3 inner frame quads.
- `GeneratePipe(PivotLocation pivotType, float radius, float height, float thickness, int subdivAxis, int subdivHeight)`: Generates outer/inner pipe walls and rim faces. If `pivotType != PivotLocation.Center`, centers pivot on vertex 1 via `pb.CenterPivot(new int[1] { 1 })`.
- `GenerateCone(PivotLocation pivotType, float radius, float height, int subdivAxis)`: Generates a cone with base ring, side triangles, and bottom fan, applying manual UV unwrapping projected with `Vector3.up`.
- `GenerateArch(PivotLocation pivotType, float angle, float radius, float width, float depth, int radialCuts, bool insideFaces, bool outsideFaces, bool frontFaces, bool backFaces, bool endCaps)`: Generates an arch with configurable face visibility flags.
- `GenerateIcosahedron(PivotLocation pivotType, float radius, int subdivisions, bool weldVertices = true, bool manualUvs = true)`: Generates an icosphere with optional vertex welding (`SharedVertex.GetSharedVerticesWithPositions`) and directional projection texture groups (`ProjectionAxis.X` through `ZNegative`).
- `GenerateTorus(PivotLocation pivotType, int rows, int columns, float innerRadius, float outerRadius, bool smooth, float horizontalCircumference, float verticalCircumference, bool manualUvs = false)`: Generates a torus with parametric revolution.
sections.godot_notes: In a Godot 4 implementation, these static methods can serve as factory functions on a `ShapeGenerator` singleton or static class returning configured `ArrayMesh` instances.
